visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A well-groomed male host with black hair wearing a white button-down shirt stands against a neutral beige studio background, gesturing with his hands while looking directly at the camera with a friendly expression. (2) The scene cuts to a medium full shot of the same man on a stage, holding a microphone and waving to an unseen audience in a brightly lit auditorium setting. (3) Transition to a dimly lit professional studio where the host, now in a black shirt, applies makeup to a female model's face; a ring light is visible in the background, casting soft highlights. (4) Close-up shot of the host's hands holding four different golden-toned skincare bottles and jars against a plain background, followed by him holding a specific round golden jar with a silver lid. (5) A series of cinematic macro shots follow, showing viscous amber-colored liquid rippling over crystal-like structures, with floating golden particles and high-contrast dramatic lighting creating a sense of luxury. (6) The host is back in the beige studio, holding a sleek rose-gold and silver bottle, pointing to its features; he then applies a drop of liquid to the back of his hand and rubs it in with his fingers. (7) He demonstrates applying the product to his own cheek and forehead with upward strokes, maintaining a peaceful expression while the background remains the neutral studio. (8) Macro shots of pink floral-like organisms and swirling golden liquid are interspersed with the host using various applicators and jars to treat his eyes and face. (9) The host concludes by holding the rose-gold bottle close to the camera, smiling and gesturing as he delivers his final remarks in the studio setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, energetic male voice speaking in Traditional Chinese over an upbeat acoustic-pop background music track with a moderate tempo of 115 BPM. The vocal tone is friendly and welcoming, with high articulation clarity and moderate pitch variability. (2) A subtle 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a shift as the host mentions his travel routine, with the background music maintaining its rhythmic piano and electronic percussion bed. (3) As the host introduces the brand 'La Mer', the music swells slightly in volume, and a 'sparkle' SFX underscores the mention of luxury ingredients. The room tone remains pristine studio-grade silence. (4) During the ingredient showcase, rhythmic 'click' and 'clink' SFX are perfectly timed with visual cuts of crystals and liquid, while the host's voice takes on a more narrative, professional quality, slowing down slightly for emphasis. (5) As he demonstrates the product application, soft 'rustling' and skin-contact sounds are audible, blended with a more ethereal, atmospheric synth layer added to the music. (6) The video concludes with the host returning to his high-arousal, encouraging tone for the CTA, as the music reaches a final bright cadence and fades out cleanly following a soft 'ding' SFX coinciding with the final brand logo appearance.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Personal Problem/Context -> Solution Introduction -> Ingredient deep-dive -> Demonstration -> Final Recommendation

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The host explicitly names the brand and products, demonstrates their use, and encourages the audience to 'experience' the collection to look ten years younger.
